blocks.html: Now is the time to unleash the superhero in you. Feel free to choose which among the two greatest superheroes you want to be. Would you be the dazzling American billionaire and philanthropist Bruce Wayne also know as Batman? Or do you want to channel the handsome Daily Planet reporter Clark Kent also know as Superman? In anticipation of the much-awaited film Batman vs. Superman Dawn of Justice, Robinsons Movieworld treats its patrons with Who Will Win? Batman vs. Superman Costume contest, where avid superhero fans, ages 15 years old and above can win exciting prizes Afficionados and fans must come and show-off their treasured Batsuit - a matching black (or blue) scalloped cape, skintight gray body suit with bat emblem, with the trademark cowl. Or wear their best Superman suit- skintight blue body suit with stylized red-and-yellow "S" symbol on its chest and the signature red cape. To join, these participants must submit 2 valid IDs and come from 1pm to 3 pm at the following Robinsons Malls: Robinsons Magnolia Atrium, March 18 – 20; Robinsons Place Manila Atrium, March 21- 23; Robinsons Galleria Atrium, March 26 -27 ; Robinsons Place Las Piñas Atrium, March 29 - 31 ; and Robinsons Galleria Cebu Atrium, April 1 – 3. One winner per day per mall will be chosen. Each winner shall receive - P1,000 (One Thousand Pesos Only) worth of ToysRus Gift Certificate; P2,000(Two Thousand Pesos Only) worth of Robinsons Department Store Gift Certificates; P2,000(Two Thousand Pesos Only) worth of RES TOE RUN Gift Certificates; and (4) Robinsons Movieworld movie cards worth P200 each with FREE four (4) 16oz Pepsi Drink and four (4) regular popcorn of any flavor. Other great deals in store for Robinsons Movieworld moviegoers and all MasterCard users who are Batman and Superman fanatics are any three (3) 16oz Pepsi product and (3) regular Popcorn (any flavor) for FREE with a minimum purchase of three (3) Batman V Superman: Dawn of Justice tickets from March 05 to 25 using MASTERCARD thru walk-in(applicable for MasterCard Credit, Debit, and Prepaid card) and online ticket purchase (applicable for MasterCard card only) via www.robinsonsmovieworld.com, ClickTheCity and Robinsons Malls App. Promo applies to the following malls- Robinsons Movieworld Galleria, Manila, Magnolia, Metro East, Forum, Antipolo, Las Pinas, Imus, Lipa, Malolos, Starmills, Pangasinan, Palawan, Santiago, Roxas, Iloilo, Tacloban, Bacolod, Dumaguete, Galleria Cebu, Butuan and Gensan.
